android.desc:
🥩 Steak Timer — Perfect Cook. Every Time.
Stop guessing. Stop Googling. Stop ruining good steak.

Steak Timer is the most precise, beautifully designed steak cooking timer on Android. Whether you're pan-searing a ribeye, reverse searing a thick fillet, or finishing on a flat top — Steak Timer guides you through every phase of the cook with intelligent timing, flip alerts, and a rest phase countdown.

🔥 Smart Timer Algorithm
Set your cut, thickness, cooking method, and start temperature — and Steak Timer calculates exactly how long to cook each side. No more overcooked medium steaks or underdone rare cuts.

⏱️ Flip Alert — Never Miss the Moment
At the exact right time, Steak Timer notifies you with sound, vibration, and an on-screen alert to flip your steak. The feature every steak app competitor is missing.

😴 Rest Phase Timer
Great steak isn't done when it leaves the pan. Steak Timer starts a rest countdown automatically so your juices redistribute properly before you cut.

🥩 Multiple Steaks, Different Doneness
Cooking for a crowd? Add up to 6 steaks with individual doneness levels — rare, medium-rare, medium, medium-well, or well-done. Steak Timer staggers the start times so everything finishes together.

📓 Cook Notebook & History
Log every cook with ratings and notes. Track what worked, what didn't, and build your personal steak playbook over time.

🍳 All Cooking Methods Supported
• Pan-sear (cast iron / stainless)
• Grill (gas & charcoal)
• Reverse sear
• Oven finish
• Sous vide finish
• Air fryer
• Flat top / Blackstone griddle

🥩 All Major Cuts Supported
Ribeye · Sirloin · Fillet / Tenderloin · New York Strip · T-Bone · Flat Iron · Porterhouse

⚙️ Fully Customizable
Choose your cut, thickness (S / M / L / XL), cooking method, start temperature (chilled or room temp), and number of steaks. Save your defaults so your next cook starts instantly.

🌡️ Cooking Temperature Guide
Get recommended pan and grill temperatures for every method — so your heat is right before the steak even hits the surface.

🎨 Premium Dark UI
A stunning steakhouse-inspired dark interface with smooth animations, satisfying haptics, and a visual steak illustration that changes as your cook progresses.

Perfect for:
Home cooks · Grill masters · Cast iron enthusiasts · Meal preppers · Anyone who refuses to eat bad steak

Download Steak Timer free. Cook like you mean it.
